description: Three-band crossover built from fourth-order Linkwitz-Riley filters, with a gain control on each band, a separate output for each and a combined output; polyphonic

params.text: Sets the level of the low band, silent at the bottom of its travel, 0dB at the middle and 6dB at the top
Sets the level of the mid band, silent at the bottom of its travel, 0dB at the middle and 6dB at the top
Sets the level of the high band, silent at the bottom of its travel, 0dB at the middle and 6dB at the top
Attenuates and inverts the CV for that band's gain
Sets where the low and mid bands split, 80Hz to 640Hz
Sets where the mid and high bands split, 1000Hz to 8000Hz

inputs.text: Changes that band's gain through its trim knob, 2V covering the whole gain range at full
Sweeps the split between the low and mid bands, 10V covering the whole range from 80Hz to 640Hz
Sweeps the split between the mid and high bands, 10V covering the whole range from 1000Hz to 8000Hz
The signal fed to all three bands, up to sixteen polyphonic channels

outputs.text: The low band on its own, after its gain
The mid band on its own, after its gain
The high band on its own, after its gain
The three bands summed after their gain settings

notes: nothing is filtered until at least one of the four outputs is patched
